name: グループの招待コードカード
prompt:
Create a single mobile invitation-code card screenshot matching the Japanese native preview at exactly 390 × 394 px. The native preview is the exact ground truth for card, text, layout, scale and colors. Use the source screenshot only to confirm card context, and use the attached embedded QR sample as the exact visual image reference. Show only this component on flat white with no device frame or browser chrome.

Match these positions: white card x=30,y=40,w=330,h=338 with a 1 px light gray #E8ECE9 border and 12 px corners; mint circular avatar x=170,y=12,w=50,h=50, overlapping the card top edge, with centered 「光」 in Meiryo Bold 14 px #064E3B; centered group title 「地域のなかま」 at x=46,y=82,w=298,h=28, Meiryo Bold 20 px #1D1D1D; centered caption 「グループの招待コード・見本」 at x=46,y=118,w=298,h=16, Meiryo Regular 12 px #6E6E6E; and the exact square QR artwork in x=108,y=162,w=174,h=174. Preserve the embedded QR pattern and centered WhatsApp logo; do not invent, alter, decode, or replace it. It is a sample reference graphic only, not an operational invitation.

Use the Japanese initial avatar, not the source portrait. Do not copy the source's English title or caption. Neither the title nor the caption is a hyperlink; keep both at their native colors without underlining. If actual hyperlink text appears, only that text should be blue #1976D2. The QR code is an image, not text. Add no buttons, copy-link controls, URLs, extra text or decorations.
reviewNotes: Text and avatar match, but card is about 15px too wide/8px left; QR is about 12px too small and its exact source pattern was altered. Overlay review completed. No visible hyperlink; use v002 for geometry and exact QR preservation.
